title: Application and Price Trends for NEA Hawker Stalls
what_it_is: Application and Price Trends for NEA Hawker Stalls

sections.label: Cooked food stall tender bids
sections.summary: As of 1 May 2017, government hawker centres had over 6,000 cooked food stalls, with average successful tender bids of $1,370 per month over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: As of 1 May 2017, there were over 6,000 cooked food stalls in the hawker centres owned by the Government.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The average successful tender bid for our cooked food stalls over the last three years is $1,370 per month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The lowest bid was $1 while the highest bid was $4,888.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: This excludes a recent exceptional case where there was a successful bid of $10,000 for a stall at the People's Park hawker centre, but the bidder terminated the tenancy even before he started operations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: I explained at the time that the take-up rate had consistently been very low and, moreover, most of the applicants had rejected our offered stalls and preferred to wait for a vacancy in the more popular hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: There are, therefore, no grounds to reinstate this policy nor allocate hawker stalls at market rents to only those who are retrenched or require financial assistance.

sections.label: Hawker training and incubator stalls
sections.summary: On the Hawker Centre 3.0 Committee's recommendations, a Hawker Fare series and a hawkerpreneur course with ITE College West are being started, with incubator stalls planned.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: On the recommendations of the Hawker Centre 3.0 Committee, we have launched a Hawker Fare series where aspiring hawkers can learn tips and culinary skills from veteran hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have started this series and it has been overwhelmingly subscribed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are also going to start a hawkerpreneur course with ITE College West where they will teach aspiring hawkers simple skills on how to run a hawker stall, pricing and so on, as well as even how to apply and bid for a hawker stall so that they will be able to bid at a realistic price, at a rent that their business can sustain.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition, at the end of the year, we are looking at introducing some incubator stalls at some of our hawker centres.
